calendarFaqs.q: Are all religious and community observances on the SFUSD calendar no-school days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. SFUSD says the Academic Calendar's observance list is intended to build awareness of dates that may affect attendance. Districtwide closures and recesses are identified separately in the Academic and School Holiday calendars.

calendarFaqs.q: Which SFUSD calendar should families use?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the Academic Calendar for instructional dates, recesses, and the first and last day of instruction. Use the School Holiday Calendar for a one-page view of school closures and breaks. The Work Calendar is primarily for employee schedules.

calendarFaqs.q: When do students return after SFUSD Winter Recess?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Recess runs December 20 through December 31, 2027. Students return for spring instruction on Monday, January 3, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When do students return after SFUSD Spring Recess?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Recess runs March 24 through March 31, 2028. Students return Monday, April 3.

calendarFaqs.q: Does SFUSD have school on Lunar New Year in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: No. SFUSD identifies Wednesday, January 26, 2028 as Lunar New Year Observance, with school sites and Early Education Department programs closed.

calendarFaqs.q: What is the February 18, 2028 School Recess Day?
calendarFaqs.a: SFUSD identifies Friday, February 18 as a School Recess Day. School sites and Early Education Department programs are closed.

whatsNew.title: What Changed from 2026–27
content: The first day moves from August 17 in 2026–27 to August 16 in 2027–28.
The last day moves from June 2 in 2026–27 to June 1 in 2027–28.
Fall Recess moves from November 23–27 in 2026–27 to November 22–26 in 2027–28.
Spring Recess moves from March 26–April 2 in 2026–27 to March 24–31 in 2027–28.

customSections.label: School Closures vs. Religious and Community Observances
customSections.content: SFUSD's Academic Calendar also lists major religious and community observances. Those dates are not all districtwide school closures. SFUSD describes the observance list as an awareness resource for dates that may affect attendance. On this page, “Holiday” and “No School” are reserved for dates SFUSD identifies as school closures or no-school days.

customSections.label: Which SFUSD Calendar Should I Use?
customSections.content: SFUSD publishes several calendars for different purposes. The 2027–28 Academic Calendar is available in English, Chinese, Vietnamese, Samoan, Spanish, Tagalog, and Arabic from the district calendar hub.

definitions.description: Use this for instructional dates, the first and last day of instruction, recesses, and SFUSD's list of major religious and community observances.
Use this one-page calendar when you mainly need districtwide school holidays, closures, and recesses.
This is primarily for employee workdays. A date on the Work Calendar does not automatically mean students have the day off.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 13, 2026 using SFUSD's current 2027–28 Academic, School Holiday, and Work calendars.
sourceReviewDetails: The August 3 Academic Calendar confirms August 16 as the first day of fall instruction, June 1 as the last day of spring instruction, and 180 total student days split 82/98 between fall and spring.

We reviewed the complete color-coded Academic Calendar and its major religious and community observance list. SFUSD says that list is intended to increase awareness; it is not a list of districtwide school closures.

The School Holiday Calendar separately confirms districtwide holidays, Fall Recess, Winter Recess, the January 3 return date, Lunar New Year, the February 18 School Recess Day, Spring Recess, and the April 3 return date.
The Work Calendar covers employee schedules. We use it to explain the official calendar system, not to infer additional student no-school days.

The Academic and School Holiday calendars note that some Early Education and year-round PK programs remain open during dates marked as school recesses. The consecutive-day break notes on this page apply to students following the standard SFUSD academic calendar.
